title: Keto Pork Stir Fry
description: A low-carb, quick-cooked dish made with pork and stir-fry vegetables. Perfect for a keto meal.

ingredients.name: Soy sauce (low-carb)
ingredients.notes: Or make your own using a keto-friendly ingredient

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the cabbage, bell pepper, and green onions to the skillet and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Return the pork to the skillet and stir in the soy sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the pork is coated in the sauce and the vegetables are tender.
